services.title: Emergency Burst Pipes & Leaks
services.desc: Water flooding your home? We'll locate the source, isolate the damage, and repair or replace the pipework. Most jobs finished the same day.

services.title: Blocked Drains & Sewers
services.desc: Sluggish sink or backed-up toilet? We use CCTV surveys and high-pressure jetting to clear blockages and identify root causes without unnecessary digging.

services.desc: Full install of new suites, taps, and pipework. We handle design, supply, and fitting — finishing on time and leaving your space spotless.

services.title: Central Heating Systems

about_pullquote: We turn up when we say we'll turn up, fix it right, and charge you fairly.
about_para_1: Mayday Plumbing Solutions has been serving Bolton homes and businesses for over 15 years. Founded on the principle that emergency plumbing shouldn't mean sky-high bills or being left in the cold, we've built a reputation for honest, fast, and professional work. Our team carries a full range of parts and tools on every van, so most faults are diagnosed and resolved on the first visit.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we answer the phone 24/7, we never charge a call-out fee, and we give straight advice without trying to upsell. We're not the cheapest, but we're the most reliable — and that's what matters when it's 2am and your heating has gone out. Every member of the team is fully Gas Safe registered, OFTEC certified, and fully insured.
reviews_heading: What Bolton Homeowners Say About Mayday Plumbing

reviews.text: Woke up to a burst pipe under the kitchen sink at half six in the morning. Rang Mayday expecting the usual nightmare — instead, Dean was round in 45 minutes, had it sorted by 8. No faffing about, no silly charges, just a proper job. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had our old boiler die just before Christmas. Nightmare timing. Mayday quoted £2,400 for a new Worcester and fitted it three days later. Engineers were tidy, polite, and left the kitchen spotless. Two weeks in and we're saving about £30 a month on our bills. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend.
reviews.author: Rebecca L.

reviews.text: Blocked drain backing up into the bathroom. Tried a local cowboy first — cost me £150 and nothing changed. Mayday came the same afternoon, did a CCTV survey, found the problem 30 metres down the line, and sorted it with jetting. Fair price and honest from the start. That's what you want.
reviews.author: David K.
